description: Traverses the Factory feature catalog hourly to exercise the manifest/model/state chain with log-only healthy evidence, without claiming per-feature E2E verification; genuine run failures surface through deployment monitoring, while scoped Slack response events retain exact-revision incident handling.

skills.description: Verify Factory features against their named end-to-end procedures and supported safety boundaries.

SLACK_CHANNEL.description: Slack channel whose existing guardian response events may be handled (for example factory-health or general). Scheduled healthy checks do not post.

SLACK_USER_WILL.description: Slack user ID for Will, authorized to confirm an existing guardian response thread.

SLACK_USER_KHALIQ.description: Slack user ID for Khaliq, authorized to confirm an existing guardian response thread.

GUARDIAN_VERIFY_MAX_TIER.description: Highest verification tier the guardian may automate; tiers above it remain MANUAL.

GUARDIAN_LIVE_VERIFY_OPT_IN.description: Comma-separated feature IDs or named procedures explicitly authorized for tier 3-5 disposable checks.

FACTORY_VERIFY_CANARY_ISSUE.description: Disposable provider issue selected for explicitly opted-in tier-3 checks.

FACTORY_VERIFY_CONFIG.description: Disposable Factory config selected for explicitly opted-in provider checks.

FACTORY_GUARDIAN_FLEET_OPT_IN.description: Explicit authorization to use a disposable fleet for a tier-4 procedure.

FACTORY_GUARDIAN_CLOUD_OPT_IN.description: Explicit authorization to use disposable writable Cloud resources for a tier-5 procedure.
